bill.title: An Act providing for prohibited conduct involving algorithmic pricing structures and artificial intelligence, for enforcement by Attorney General and for civil remedies; and imposing criminal penalties.

action.description: Referred to Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure

posted_text:
🧠 AI, Data Centers & Crypto
PA SB 1507 — PA Bill Could Crack Down on AI Price Fixing

Pennsylvania is considering a law that could target businesses using artificial intelligence to set prices. This bill, dubbed the Collusive Algorithms Act, aims to stop companies from using ‘algorithmic pricing structures’ – essentially AI – to unfairly raise prices by sharing secret information about competitors. ...
